data_basis: Exact transcription of reported digestate liquid/fiber recovery ranges, nutrient concentrations, leachate results and qualitative statements. Wet-mass, dry-mass, concentration and scenario bases remain distinct.
license: No explicit reuse license identified for the accepted manuscript. This file contains factual observations transcribed with attribution; no figures, table images or manuscript text are reproduced.
applicability: Reference-only digestate evidence from the roadside-grass pilot and large landfill-cell configurations. It does not establish GreenHub residual digestate flows, product grade, fertilizer compliance or nutrient substitution.
limitations: All rows remain reference-only and are not runtime defaults or calculation inputs.

Text-reported liquid (47–57%), fiber fresh-mass (52–66%) and fiber dry-mass (5–8%) fractions lack paired run-level flows and fully specified compatible denominators; do not sum them as a closed balance.
The article prints potassium as 1,808 kg K/t DM, exceeding total sample mass. The literal value and reported N:P:K ratio are retained but quarantined; no unit correction is guessed.
Reported N and P concentrations lack variance/sample-count detail in the cited passage and are not flow-weighted nutrient recovery quantities.
Landfill leachate N and chloride are separate from pilot digestate concentrations. Sampling uncertainty is unavailable; qualitative low pollutant wording does not establish regulatory compliance.
The approximately 2% dry-fiber share is an author-synthesized regional scenario statement, not a measured reactor recovery coefficient.
Supporting chart workbooks/raw time-series values were unavailable with the accepted manuscript; only values explicitly stated in text are transcribed.
No explicit reuse license was identified. The institutional repository record and article DOI are linked for provenance.
curation_note: The DOI identifies the article. The local dataset URN identifies this GreenHub transcription version; it is not an externally registered DOI or persistent identifier.
